name: Kirkland Signature Organic Thai Hom Mali Jasmine Rice (50 lb Bag)
whyItWorks: Premium polished white jasmine rice is practically 100% absorbable starch with minimal residue. It calms nausea, regulates stool consistency, and provides clean glucose for cells without irritating the colon.
